# Dialog

> Modal dialog for focused tasks, confirmations, and custom panels.

This file matches the installed `dialog` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/dialog.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/dialog.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `button`
- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/popup-knobs`: `popupKnobs`, types `PopupKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/popup-parts`: `popupBackdropStyle`, `PopupCloseButton`, `PopupArrowShape`, types `PopupCloseButtonProps`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/dialog`: `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogClose`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogBody`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, types `DialogProps`, `DialogContentProps`, `DialogCloseProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger />
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle />
      <DialogDescription />
    </DialogHeader>
    <DialogBody>
      <Input />
    </DialogBody>
    <DialogFooter>
      <DialogClose />
    </DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogBody,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/input";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const termsSections = [
  { title: "Workspace data", body: "Projects, deployments, and logs stay in the region you choose when the workspace is created." },
  { title: "Seats", body: "Each member with write access uses one seat. Viewers and billing contacts are free." },
  { title: "Usage limits", body: "Build minutes and bandwidth reset on the first day of each billing period." },
  { title: "Overages", body: "Usage above the plan allowance is billed at the end of the period at the listed rates." },
  { title: "Support", body: "Priority support answers within one business day. Critical incidents are handled around the clock." },
  { title: "Retention", body: "Deployment logs are kept for 30 days and audit logs for one year." },
  { title: "Cancellation", body: "Cancel at any time. The workspace stays active until the end of the paid period." },
  { title: "Exports", body: "Export projects and environment variables from workspace settings before the workspace is deleted." },
  { title: "Changes", body: "We announce changes to these terms by email at least 30 days before they take effect." },
];

export function PrimitiveDialogExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <Dialog>
        <DialogTrigger render={<Button variant="surface">Edit profile</Button>} />
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Edit profile</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>Update your display name. Changes are saved to your workspace.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogBody>
            <Input aria-label="Display name" defaultValue="Ada Lovelace" />
          </DialogBody>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose>Cancel</DialogClose>
            <DialogClose variant="solid" tone="primary">
              Save changes
            </DialogClose>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
      <Dialog>
        <DialogTrigger render={<Button variant="surface">Review plan terms</Button>} />
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Plan terms</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>The header and footer stay in place while the body scrolls.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogBody className="gap-4">
            {termsSections.map((section) => (
              <div key={section.title} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                <Text weight="medium">{section.title}</Text>
                <Text tone="muted">{section.body}</Text>
              </div>
            ))}
          </DialogBody>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose>Decline</DialogClose>
            <DialogClose variant="solid" tone="primary">
              Accept terms
            </DialogClose>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- `dialog`

  - `description`: `data-popup-kind` (`dialog`)
  - `footer`: `data-popup-kind` (`dialog`)
  - `header`: `data-popup-kind` (`dialog`)
  - `title`: `data-popup-kind` (`dialog`)
  - `trigger`: `data-disabled`, `data-popup-kind` (`dialog`), `data-popup-open`
